positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bynder is the fastest way to professionally manage creative files. Teams get on the same page for real-time collaborative edits and approvals, easy file sharing and storage, auto-formatting for channels and file types - it provides one central hub for all company materials and messaging. With company creative at your fingertips, your next big idea is a click away.

www.bynder.com

positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
» Improved overall code quality by refactoring legacy code and reviews Github pull requests to ensure committed code does not introduce new technical debt

» Oversaw error tracking using tools such as Cypress, CodeClimate, and CircleCI

» Collaborated with team for code and onboarding documentation using StackOverflow Teams

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
» Developed reusable ReactJS components built on front end frameworks including but not limited to react-bootstrap and material-ui to build interfaces and internal design systems to be used across multiple applications

» Wrote and maintained tests using Jest, Mocha, Enzyme, and Karma

» Wrote automated Cypress tests and mentored QA specialists in JavaScript in transition from manual to automated testing

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description: Developed white labeled product and course implementations for some of the nation’s leading financial institutions using pure HTML and CSS / SCSS

positions.title: System Developer Senior Analyst
positions.description:
» Contributed to conversion of client’s legacy applications to integrate with existing, more modern applications to enable Single Sign On (SSO)

» Implemented design wire frames created by UI / UX teams for modernization of client applications using AngularJS and development team pattern libraries

» Maintained data and data functions in both legacy and modern applications using Java Spring MVC

positions.title: System Developer Analyst
positions.description:
» Full-stack web development: utilization of various technologies with particular focuses on Spring MVC, AngularJS, and Java

» Assists in maintenance of two client applications through performance improvements and client change requests

» Works on a web development team of more than 30 to support and fulfill client requests

» Collaborates with Functional Testing and Digital (UX) teams to ensure fulfillment of client's project requirements to deliver high-standard applications

honors.title: Above & Beyond Award
honors.description: Recognized by team leadership for “dedication and outstanding contribution integral to [our] continued success.”

honors.title: PersoniFi
honors.description:
Awarded to an individual who:
1) exemplifies EVERFI qualities 
2) Went above and beyond for a partner, prospect, or team member 
3) Stood out as a team player who improved outcomes for a team and left a mark 
4) Did something remarkable to leave a lasting impact.
